controllerRule: The 16:00 controller must not call image generation itself. It creates one fresh isolated Article Cover Image Job for each eligible same-date article and each job handles exactly one article.
briefFallbackRule: A missing same-date Article Cover Brief must not by itself prevent an upgrade attempt. Derive a concise positive visual brief only from that article's own candidate title, subtitle/research question and same-date Research Object identity.
targetRule: Replace only the exact existing candidate coverPath after the upgraded raster passes review; otherwise preserve the baseline bytes.
imageInstruction: Each fresh Article Cover Image Job sends only its single article's positive visual brief to ChatGPT built-in image generation and must not carry any other article or control-plane context into the image handoff.
assetRule: Persist the original generated raster file, never a conversation preview, UI thumbnail, screenshot, report composite, or downscaled derivative. The accepted raster must be at least 1536x864 and approximately 16:9, and those dimensions must be re-verified from the decoded bytes fetched from latest main after persistence.
acceptance: Accept a replacement only when it is clearly article-specific, attractive at thumbnail scale, a real full-resolution raster, at least 1536x864, approximately 16:9, and materially better than the baseline. Simple baseline quality is already valid and is never a reason to force replacement.
